headline: 'Unsuitable for Investment in Korea' Bloomberg Column: Financial Services Commission Firmly Refutes
summary: The Financial Services Commission issued a press release disputing a Bloomberg column titled 'South Korea Is Becoming an Unsuitable Investment Destination,' saying some cited statistics do not match the facts. KOSPI remains sluggish near the 6,000 level.
why: The Financial Services Commission is South Korea's financial regulator, and foreign perceptions of its markets affect capital flows into KOSPI.
